document-parser.title: Document Processing Assistant
document-parser.subtitle: Extract and format key information from documents in seconds. No more copy & paste.
document-parser.description: Eliminate tedious data entry  — your AI Assistant automatically extracts key details from customer forms, PDFs, invoices, and reports — then instantly updates your CRM with complete, accurate information.

voice-of-customer-intel.title: Customer Insights Assistant
voice-of-customer-intel.subtitle: Know everything customers are saying about your company
voice-of-customer-intel.description: Your AI Assistant scans customer reviews, support tickets, sales calls and social media to understand what customers are saying about your company. It generate a report with the top 5 positive and negative comments.

sales-calls-mining.title: Sales Calls Insights Assistant
sales-calls-mining.subtitle: All your team's sales calls, distilled into key insights
sales-calls-mining.description: Your AI Assistant reads all sales calls transcript and summarizes it for you. Stay informed about what your leads are saying about your company and products.

competitor-monitoring.title: Competitor Monitoring Assistant
competitor-monitoring.subtitle: Track your competitors' every move & react before anyone else
competitor-monitoring.description: Your AI Assistant monitors your competitors' websites, product releases and social media posts and generate a report with the most important information.

internal-knowledge-assistant.title: Your Company's Internal ChatGPT
internal-knowledge-assistant.subtitle: Instant access to internal docs and projects knowledge
internal-knowledge-assistant.description: Empower your team to work more efficiently with instant access to internal docs, projects, and knowledge — no more wasted time searching or waiting for answers.

supplier-rfq-assistant.title: Supplier Sourcing Assistant
supplier-rfq-assistant.subtitle: Speed up your sourcing process with suppliers' catalog analysis and RFQ outreach
supplier-rfq-assistant.description: Your AI Assistant scans the web for new suppliers, extracts catalog data into Excel, and prepares RFQ drafts in minutes, saving hours of manual research and outreach.

supplier-offer-comparison.title: Supplier Quotes Comparison Assistant
supplier-offer-comparison.subtitle: Automatically extract supplier offers from various formats and compare them in a single view
supplier-offer-comparison.description: Your AI Assistant reads supplier emails and attachments (PDF, Excel, CSV), extracts key offer details like price, quantity, and delivery terms, and generates ready-to-use comparison tables for faster, more consistent decisions.

invoice-processing.title: Invoice Processing Assistant
invoice-processing.subtitle: Automate your entire invoice workflow
invoice-processing.description: Your AI Assistant reads vendor invoices, extracts key accounting data, validates them against purchase orders, and instantly alerts you to any mismatches.

customer-support-rep-assistant.title: Customer Support Assistant
customer-support-rep-assistant.subtitle: Reduce your time to resolution with smart workflows
customer-support-rep-assistant.description: Boost your customer support team's efficiency — your AI Assistant reads incoming emails, pulls the right policies or SOPs, and drafts compliant, personalized responses, cutting time to resolution and improving customer satisfaction.

website-chatbot.title: Website Chatbot Assistant
website-chatbot.subtitle: Your dedicated 24/7 Website Front-Desk Agent.
website-chatbot.description: Turn visitors into customers with instant answers — your AI Assistant engages prospects on your website 24/7, delivering accurate, up-to-date responses about your products and services, boosting conversions and reducing support requests.
